## About
Packer Norris Parts is a joint venture between Al Packer's White Marsh Ford and Norris Ford of Dundalk, both well-known Baltimore Ford dealerships. We've grown into one of the country's largest distributors of Ford and Lincoln/Mercury parts, and we still run it like a neighborhood parts counter.
We work with collision repair shops, fleets and government agencies, Ford and Lincoln dealers, mechanical repair shops, and individual Ford owners and enthusiasts. Our retail store is open to the public, so if you're working on your own truck, come on in.
Our customers have given us a 4.5 rating across 136 Google reviews. If you have a question about a part, call us or stop by, and bring your VIN.

## Services
- Ford and Motorcraft parts: Genuine Ford maintenance and repair parts, Power Stroke diesel and Super Duty parts, and Motorcraft parts. Our staff can help with questions on any of them.
- Online Ford parts catalog: Place your order through our online Ford parts catalog whenever it suits you.
- Parts delivery to businesses: Our drivers deliver to businesses on our routes in parts of Maryland, Delaware, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Northern Virginia and Washington DC. Send us a request through the contact form if you're near one of our routes.
- PNP parts accounts: Shops and businesses can request a PNP parts account and qualify for preferred pricing.

## FAQ
Q: Is the store open to the public?
A: Yes. Our retail parts store on Citation Road is open to the public, and we help Ford owners and enthusiasts as well as shops.

Q: What are the ways to place an order?
A: By phone, fax, email, online through our Ford parts catalog, or in person at the store.

Q: Can you ship parts outside your delivery area?
A: Yes. If we can't get to you with our own delivery, we ship parts by UPS or FedEx anywhere in the U.S.

Q: What should customers have ready when calling or coming in?
A: A reviewer suggested having your make, model, year and VIN handy so we can find the right part.
